title: Gaussian Process Decorrelation for Spatiotemporal Deep Learning-Based Snow Water Equivalent Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2609.22182v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In the Western United States, snowmelt is essential to the agricultural industry in addition to being a key source of municipal drinking water. Consequently, accurate snowpack forecasting is critical for water policy and management. Automated Snow Telemetry (SNOTEL) stations provide accurate daily measurements of snow water equivalent (SWE) that exhibit strong correlations in space and in time. translated_title: 基于时空深度学习的高斯过程去相关雪水当量预测
translated_abstract: 在美国西部，融雪不仅是农业产业的重要支撑，也是城市饮用水的主要来源之一。因此，准确的雪层预测对水资源政策和管理至关重要。自动雪遥测（SNOTEL）站点提供精确的雪水当量（SWE）每日测量数据，这些数据在空间和时间上均表现出强相关性。我们致力于解决在整个SNOTEL网络中预测未来SWE值的问题。具体而言，我们使用基于高斯过程的线性变换去除空间相关性，然后再对去相关后的SWE数据训练长短期记忆（LSTM）神经网络。这种方法使LSTM能够在每个站点学习到干净的时间信号。我们证明，这种空间与时间成分的分离方法比多个基线模型取得了更好的预测效果。此外，我们还引入共形预测来量化预测的不确定性。
tldr: 该论文提出先用高斯过程线性变换去除SNOTEL站点间雪水当量数据的空间相关性，再对去相关数据训练LSTM神经网络学习各站点的时间信号，并结合共形预测量化不确定性，从而比多个基线模型取得了更优的雪水当量预测效果。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes using a Gaussian Process-based linear transformation to remove spatial correlations in SNOTEL snow water equivalent data before training an LSTM network on the decorrelated data, combined with conformal prediction for uncertainty quantification, achieving better predictive performance than multiple baseline models.
